news.title: Netflix secures exclusive 2030 World Cup broadcast rights in Spain
news.lede: Netflix added to its sports portfolio on Tuesday by landing the rights to broadcast the 2030 World Cup to the viewing audience in Spain and Andorra. Spain is one of three main co-hosts of the next edition of the FIFA World Cup, along with Portugal and Morocco. The first three games of the tournament will take place in South America. While FIFA prefers a free over-the-air broadcast partner over a streaming service, the deal includes a plan to air one match per day on public television.

news.title: FIFA says it's not moving forward with controversial World Cup sell-off plan
news.lede: FIFA President Gianni Infantino said Friday that the international soccer governing body would not be moving forward with a controversial proposal to sell stakes in future competitions to private investors. The move came after Europe's governing body for football said it would boycott the World Cup over the plan. FIFA will not be moving forward with a controversial proposal to sell stakes in future competitions to private investors. The plan had been met with boycotts and a top resignation.

news.title: New Zealand lose 4-0 to impressive Morocco at FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: New Zealand have lost their opening game at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup, beaten 4-0 by hosts Morocco. The Young Football Ferns put up strong resistance in a scoreless first half, with goalkeeper Nienke Holland thwarting the wave of Moroccan attacks that created 16 attempts on goal. Led by Holland’s example, the New Zealand defenders scrambled to keep an impressive Morocco side at bay. Main photo: The New Zealanders block a Moroccan attack.

news.title: All 47 Saudi Pro League players selected for 2026 FIFA World Cup
news.lede: The 2026 FIFA World Cup will feature some of the biggest names in world football, and the Saudi Pro League is set to have a sizeable presence on the sport’s biggest stage. A total of 47 players from 18 national teams, including 25 representing Saudi Arabia, are contracted to Saudi Pro League clubs heading into the tournament, underlining the league’s growing influence beyond the Kingdom. That figure rises to 49 players from 19 nations when including Curaçao defender Juriën Gaari of Abha and Saudi Arabia goalkeeper Mohammed Al-Owais of Al-Ula, who both play outside the Saudi top flight. A post shared by SPOTV Indonesia (@spotv.indonesia).

news.title: Ronaldinho to make football comeback aged 46
news.lede: More than a decade after his last professional appearance, Brazilian superstar Ronaldinho is set for a comeback. The former world player of the year is to play in Italy’s third tier. While Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are still playing at 39 and 41 respectively, most football fans thought Ronaldinho belonged to another footballing era. That all changed in June, when Italian Serie C club, Ravenna, announced that the former Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and AC Milan forward would play for them in the upcoming season.

news.title: The CommBank ParaMatildas have defeated Ireland 19-0 to begin their IFCPF Women’s World Cup title defence.
news.lede: Annmarie De Uriarte scored eight in the comprehensive victory, while Georgia Beikoff scored four, and both Carly Salmon and Eloise Northam added hat tricks. Head Coach Charlotte Ercil named an experienced starting five to begin the tournament. Katelyn Smith started in goal, while Tahlia Blanshard, Georgia Beikoff, Eloise Northam and Annmarie De Uriarte completed the side. De Uriarte got scoring underway in the third minute.
